newsitem.title: USA: U S West to sue over regulatory ruling.
newsitem.headline: U S West to sue over regulatory ruling.

text.p: U S West Communications Group said Tuesday it will file a lawsuit challenging a Minnesota Public Utilities Commission decision not to modify an earlier ruling on local telecommunications networks.
At issue is a November 15 ruling that specifies the terms and conditions under which local telephone service providers will interconnect with U S West's network, the company said.
U S West contends the monthly connection rate of $12.03 is substantially below what it costs to provide a telephone line.
The company plans to appeal the matter in a federal court in a lawsuit similar to legal actions taken by some of its competitors.
U S West shares were trading up 5/8 at 32-7/8.
